description: CC-1.2 / CC-1.3 step 4 semantic mapping for the seven M1a priority tools after description reduction. Each entry records retained meaning, where it lives post-edit, local verification hooks, and appendix-independent fragments (routing guide may be disabled).

tabulate_cached_result.retainedMeaning: Full-table cached transforms (not fetch paging); within-mode operation order (group_metric: filters → groupBy/measures → derived → having → sorts → maxItems/offset/fields projection); output completeness vs sampleRows/totalRows
verificationCases: Off top-level: fetch_cached_result browse-only + named decision modes
Schema mode description states group_metric pipeline order (derived/having/sorts/pagination/projection)
filters/measures/having include ThingWorx predicate key shapes
Lazy blurb identifies cached tabular transforms

query_entities.retainedMeaning: Template/shape XOR listing; taxonomy-first routing; hierarchy intersect; filter-field provenance (query.filters); totalRows vs totalCount semantics; not spotlight
verificationCases: Top-level: exactly one of thingTemplate or thingShape (XOR)
Top-level: totalRowsInferred and not spotlight_search
Schema query: ThingWorx-shaped filters under query
Schema includeConcreteTemplate: inheritance column when thingTemplate set
Appendix-independent: hierarchy intersect + totalRows count semantics
Lazy blurb leads with listing Things by template/shape

build_chart_from_tabular_result.retainedMeaning: Qualifying tabular sources; cacheId handle rules; kind XOR intent; column shape (xColumn/yColumn/series); multi-chart + CHART_EMITTED success state
verificationCases: Top-level: kind XOR intent phrase + CHART_EMITTED + multi-chart
Schema source: last_invoke latest-wins + cache_id arms
Schema kind/intent: mutually exclusive
Schema series/seriesColumn: multi-series column shape
Lazy blurb identifies tabular chart builder
topLevelMustContainPhrase: one turn may emit several charts

invoke_service.retainedMeaning: Generic service call; real signature via discovery; scope/widening when omitting filters; parameters nesting; no-input services omit parameters (no separate empty-object rule in this slice)

protectedMeaningNotes.noArgVsEmptyArg: Slice documents zero-input services called with no parameters (top-level) and optional parameters when the service has no inputs (schema). No distinct empty-object {} vs omit rule is stated.

verificationCases: Top-level: parameters nesting + discover before unknown inputs + no parameters for zero-input services
Schema parameters: nested under parameters + optional when no inputs
Appendix-independent: no list_entities_by_type substitute + scope widening warning
Lazy blurb identifies generic service invocation

query_entities_by_taxonomy.retainedMeaning: resolve_asset_type first; CriticalProperties projection; LookupProperties OR filter; hierarchy scope; EMPTY/INLINE/LARGE completeness; totalCount (not totalRows)
verificationCases: Top-level: resolve_asset_type + CriticalProperties + branch completeness + totalCount
Schema LookupProperties: OR exact match
Schema hierarchyNodeName present
Appendix-independent: taxonomy resolution + totalCount semantics
Lazy first-round advertised tool keeps EntityType/EntityName required

query_property_history.retainedMeaning: Canonical thingName; numeric vs value-stream paths; timezone-aware windows (ISO UTC vs calendarPhrase user_timezone); real query bounds vs chart-only requestedTimeRange; sampleRows vs exact aggregates via actions

protectedMeaningNotes.propertyUnits: No explicit property-unit prose remains in this tool's reduced descriptions; numeric values use server-resolved property metadata (see propertyName base-type routing) and optional y_label override only.

verificationCases: Top-level: canonical thingName + UTC alignment for chart/query bounds
Schema startTime/endTime: ISO-8601
Schema calendarPhrase: user_timezone
Schema relativeDuration/calendarPhrase: mutual exclusion
Schema actions: numeric aggregates (not sample inference)
Schema requestedTimeRange: chart-only window when query bounds omitted
Appendix-independent: timezone + sample vs aggregates
Lazy blurb mentions property history

build_history_overlay_chart.retainedMeaning: 2-6 numeric traces; per-series time windows; xAxisMode coordinate units (absolute timestamps; elapsed seconds from window start; normalized 0..1 shape); real history fetch boundaries
verificationCases: Top-level: 2-6 traces + three xAxisMode modes including elapsed_time
Schema xAxisMode: seconds-from-start and 0..1 normalized coordinate semantics
Schema series: per-entry time window resolution
Schema propertyName: same numeric property on every series
Appendix-independent: prefer over repeated query_property_history
Lazy blurb mentions overlay traces
